questions.stem: The World Trade Organization (WTO) administers global trade rules and adjudicates trade disputes among its 164 member nations. Which European city permanently hosts the WTO headquarters?

options.option_text: Geneva, Switzerland — seat of global trade governance since 1995
Brussels, Belgium — headquarters of NATO and major EU institutions
Vienna, Austria — home of OPEC and IAEA secretariats
Nairobi, Kenya — hosts UNEP and UN-Habitat regional offices

questions.explanation: The WTO has been headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland since its establishment in 1995, inheriting the premises of its predecessor GATT. Vienna is a common distractor because it hosts OPEC and IAEA — both major international bodies — but neither is the WTO.

questions.stem: INTERPOL, coordinating police cooperation across 195 member countries, relocated its General Secretariat from the Paris region in 1989. Which French city has hosted INTERPOL's permanent General Secretariat since that move?

options.option_text: Paris, France — original INTERPOL base before the 1989 relocation
Strasbourg, France — home of the Council of Europe and its court
Lyon, France — current INTERPOL General Secretariat since 1989
Marseille, France — France's second-largest city and major port

questions.explanation: INTERPOL's General Secretariat moved from Saint-Cloud (near Paris) to Lyon in 1989. Paris is the most tempting wrong answer because it was the historical base and is France's capital, but the current permanent HQ is definitively in Lyon.

questions.stem: The OPEC Secretariat was first established in Geneva in 1961, one year after OPEC's founding in Baghdad. It was subsequently shifted to its present permanent location in 1965. Where does the OPEC Secretariat currently sit?

options.option_text: Brussels, Belgium — seats NATO and major European Union bodies
Vienna, Austria — neutral European venue chosen after Geneva exit
Geneva, Switzerland — OPEC's original secretariat city until 1965
The Hague, Netherlands — legal hub housing multiple UN tribunals

questions.explanation: OPEC relocated its Secretariat from Geneva to Vienna on 1 September 1965, drawn by Austria's political neutrality. Geneva is the most common wrong answer precisely because it was OPEC's founding secretariat city — the question exploits this historical pivot.

questions.stem: The International Criminal Court (ICC) is legally and functionally distinct from the International Court of Justice (ICJ): the ICC prosecutes individuals for genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity. Both bodies share the same host country. In which Dutch city is the ICC headquartered?

options.option_text: Amsterdam, Netherlands — the country's financial and cultural capital
Rotterdam, Netherlands — Europe's largest and busiest seaport hub
Utrecht, Netherlands — historic seat of the Dutch university system
The Hague, Netherlands — legal capital hosting both ICC and ICJ

questions.explanation: The ICC, operational since 2002 under the Rome Statute, is headquartered at The Hague — the same city as the ICJ. Amsterdam is a frequent wrong choice because it is the constitutional capital, but The Hague is the seat of government and international judicial institutions in the Netherlands.

questions.stem: The Commonwealth Secretariat has served as the central intergovernmental body of the 56-member Commonwealth of Nations since 1965. The Secretariat operates from Marlborough House, a historic building gifted by the British Crown. In which city is Marlborough House located?

options.option_text: Ottawa, Canada — site of several Commonwealth regional liaison offices
Canberra, Australia — federal capital of the largest Commonwealth economy
New Delhi, India — Commonwealth's most populous member-state capital
London, United Kingdom — Marlborough House has hosted the Secretariat since 1965

questions.explanation: Marlborough House, Pall Mall, London was granted by Queen Elizabeth II to the Commonwealth Secretariat when it was created in 1965. New Delhi is a plausible distractor given India's centrality in Commonwealth affairs, but the administrative seat has always been in London.

questions.stem: BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation) links South and Southeast Asian nations. Its permanent Secretariat, established in 2014, is central to India's 'Neighbourhood First' policy and is often confused with SAARC's Secretariat city. Where is the BIMSTEC permanent Secretariat located?

options.option_text: Colombo, Sri Lanka — island nation at the southern tip of the subcontinent
Kathmandu, Nepal — city that also hosts the permanent SAARC Secretariat
Dhaka, Bangladesh — BIMSTEC permanent Secretariat established here in 2014
Yangon, Myanmar — BIMSTEC's Southeast Asian gateway member nation

questions.explanation: The BIMSTEC Secretariat was established in Dhaka, Bangladesh in 2014. Kathmandu is the single most dangerous distractor because it correctly hosts the SAARC Secretariat — candidates routinely conflate the two regional bodies. BIMSTEC ≠ SAARC; Dhaka ≠ Kathmandu.

questions.stem: The New Development Bank (NDB), created by the five BRICS nations via the Fortaleza Agreement in 2014, is the first major multilateral development bank headquartered in China. It is often confused with the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB). The NDB and AIIB are in different Chinese cities — where is the NDB's headquarters?

options.option_text: Beijing, China — political capital that separately hosts the AIIB headquarters
Hong Kong, China — SAR functioning as Asia's premier international finance hub
Shanghai, China — NDB headquarters at the New Bund since operations began 2015
Shenzhen, China — China's leading special economic zone and tech corridor

questions.explanation: The NDB is headquartered in Shanghai (New Bund area), where it began operations in July 2015. The AIIB is in Beijing — this distinction is the core of a favourite examiner trick. Candidates who know China hosts both banks but cannot distinguish their cities will pick Beijing for the NDB, making it the most targeted wrong answer.
